# Plain Chinese

Write Chinese explanations, steps, notes and summaries that read clearly in one pass: 15 explicit rules inspired by ASD-STE100 — one idea per sentence, one meaning per term, active voice, no filler — that simplify the language without cutting any fact, number, condition or hedge. Output language: Simplified Chinese.
